question: At the fair 200 balloons were divided equally among 5 stalls. Mira's stall sold 38 balloons in the first hour, and then she received 65 more from the store tent. The fair opened at 9 o'clock. A promotion doubled her stock of balloons, and then 4 balloons popped. Her friend Dev's stall sold fewer balloons than Mira's. How many balloons does Mira have?

The parking attendant records the meter tray in cents and never converts it into dollars. At opening the tray held 173 cents, and a driver added 50 cents. The attendant emptied 191 cents into the collection bag and calls whatever stays in the tray the float. Later drivers put 70 cents into the float, then 92 cents of jammed coins were pulled out of it, and 5 cents rolled away under the kerb. How many cents are in the float?

Hamid had logged 67 minutes of violin practice on Monday. He moved a full hour, which is 60 minutes, into his lesson log, and the remainder became his free-practice log. On Tuesday he added 55 minutes to the free-practice log, then his teacher reclassified 51 of those minutes as a lesson, and 2 minutes were struck out for a timing error. His sister Laila's free-practice log shows more minutes than Hamid's. How many minutes are on Hamid's free-practice log?

Sam had 138 books on his shelves. He picked up 26 more at a library sale, then donated 105 to a charity shop. He lent 50 books to his friend Priya, who now has more books than Sam. Priya's shelf, which is a dozen feet long, can hold up to 200 books. Sam later bought 73 books at a fair. How many books does Sam have now?

Joel's daily study plan has 108 minutes of reading, 55 minutes of maths, and one hour of music, which is 60 minutes. He follows the plan every day, 7 days a week, for 5 weeks. Over that time he missed 4998 minutes of the plan through illness, and his tutor added a 71 minute extra session at the end. His friend Rina studied fewer minutes than Joel over the same weeks. How many minutes did Joel study in total?

The stadium had 237 season-ticket holders, and 38 more joined this year. The loyalty scheme started 3 years ago. Each holder receives 8 match tickets, and the club also issued 25 complimentary tickets to volunteers. Every ticket issued earns 6 loyalty points in the scheme. How many loyalty points did the club issue?

A print shop had 9 reams of paper with 216 sheets in each. The printer runs at 30 pages a minute. The shop used 238 sheets for flyers and 1665 sheets for a booklet, and then found 21 loose sheets in a drawer. Each remaining sheet was cut into 4 cards, and the cards were shared equally between 2 shops. How many cards does the first shop receive?

In the morning the news stall had 81 magazines, and a delivery of 60 more arrived; the owner, who has run the stall for a dozen years, put every magazine into the front rack. In the afternoon 52 magazines were sold from the rack, and then 47 more. In the evening 32 were sold and 5 damaged copies were removed. How many magazines are in the front rack?

The running club meets twice a week. On Monday its members logged 67 kilometres, then 47 kilometres on Tuesday, 67 on Wednesday, 24 on Thursday, and 71 on Friday. For the season challenge every kilometre logged is worth 9 challenge points. How many challenge points does the club have?

Oliver pressed 12 gallons of apple juice on Friday, 46 gallons on Saturday, and 47 gallons on Sunday. His neighbour Grace pressed fewer gallons than Oliver. He bottles the juice in pints, with 8 pints to a gallon, and sent the pints in equal shares to 4 markets. At the first market the pints were arranged equally across 5 shelves. How many pints are on the top shelf at the first market?

In the morning the bike-share station had 118 bikes; riders took 33, and 9 were sent for repair, and the staff moved every remaining bike to the east dock. Riders may keep a bike for half an hour at a time. In the afternoon 27 bikes were returned to the east dock. In the evening 36 bikes were taken from the east dock. How many bikes are in the east dock?

In the morning site manager Lena planned 205 weeks of work and wrote it up in days, at 7 days to a week, then added 23 days for inspections. In the afternoon she worked out that each day needs 6 workers, and each worker-day is billed at 7 credits. In the evening she copied the bill for 5 identical sites. Her rival Kwame's quote came to fewer credits than Lena's. How many credits is Lena's bill?

In the morning the bakery received 182 boxes of eggs with 6 eggs in each, plus 37 loose eggs, which the cook checked twice. In the afternoon the farm sent 35 more eggs. In the evening every egg went into the pancake batter, and each egg makes 4 pancakes. How many pancakes did the bakery make?

Nadia's coin jar held 138 cents. She dropped in 50 cents, which is half a dollar, and later 52 cents more. The jar is 20 centimetres tall. She took out 147 cents for a bus fare and then added 65 cents. How many cents are in the jar?

A school car wash charges 9 quarters per car. On each of 2 days, 30 cars came through. The students changed all the quarters into dollars, at 4 quarters to the dollar. They spent 34 dollars on soap and 10 dollars on wax. How many dollars do they have left?

Rafael had 167 nickels and spent 28 of them. He counted the rest in cents, at 5 cents to a nickel, and saved that same amount every week for 6 weeks. He then split his savings equally among 5 jars. Each jar is 15 centimetres tall. He added 42 cents to the first jar. How many cents are in the first jar?

A parking meter collects 126 nickels every day. The council records the total in cents, and a nickel is 5 cents. The meter ran for 7 days. The collector also found 18 cents on the ground and 33 cents wedged in the slot. How many cents did the collector record?

The camp had 93 campers, and 21 more arrived late. They were split equally into 6 cabins. Every camper in the first cabin was given 9 tokens for the camp store, and the cabin pooled them. The cabin spent 66 tokens on a canoe trip, and the rest was shared equally among its 3 counsellors. How many tokens does the head counsellor get?

In the morning Hiro's team packed 142 cartons with 8 jars in each, and half of the jars were sold at the early market. In the afternoon the remaining jars were split equally among 4 shops, and the first shop calls its share the shelf stock. In the evening the first shop received 63 more jars for its shelf stock. Hiro's rival Sato sold fewer jars than Hiro. How many jars are in the first shop's shelf stock?

Wei's stall had 206 bags of rice, each weighing 5 kilograms, which he weighed twice to be sure. He sold all of it at 9 yuan per kilogram. He paid his supplier 7605 yuan and received a 72 yuan tip. His cousin Ling's stall earned less than Wei's. How many yuan does Wei have?

At the party 40 cupcakes were shared equally among 5 children. The party started at 3 o'clock. Emma ate 7 of her cupcakes. She cut what was left into 4 pieces, then cut each piece into 2, and then cut each of those into 2 again. Her brother Jack has more cupcakes left than Emma. How many pieces does Emma have?

A tailor had 97 feet of linen, and 10 feet were water-damaged. She measured the rest in yards, at 3 feet to a yard, and used 11 yards for a dress. The linen costs 12 dollars a yard. She split the remainder into 3 equal bolts, then took 4 yards from the first bolt for a scarf. Each yard left on that bolt makes 7 napkins. How many napkins can she make from the first bolt?

In the morning the bakery had 84 pies and baked 12 more, then sold 31. In the afternoon each remaining pie was cut into 4 slices. In the evening every slice sold for 5 dollars. How many dollars did the slices bring in?

In the morning the vineyard counted 150 bearing vines, then found 20 more in the lower field and 8 along the fence. In the afternoon each vine gave 5 bunches, and each bunch weighed 8 ounces. In the evening 4704 ounces were pressed for juice. How many ounces of grapes remain?

Tessa and Ruby split 236 raffle tickets, and Tessa took half. Tessa then bought 61 more tickets, so she had more than Ruby. The draw is at 8 o'clock. Each ticket earns 5 points, and Tessa spent 579 points on a prize. How many points does Tessa have left?
